fixes.current: <jp reading="ぜひあしたまでにやらないと">是非あしたまでにやらないと</jp>
fixes.fix: <jp reading="かならずあしたまでにやらないと">必ずあしたまでにやらないと</jp>
fixes.why: 是非 selects volition/request/invitation (〜たい, 〜てください, 〜ましょう); with the obligation 〜ないと and an external deadline the native adverb is 必ず. Swaps the whole <jp> element so the reading attribute changes with the text (same tag multiset, no prose inside a tag); the pt-BR gloss 'preciso fazer até amanhã sem falta' still matches 必ず.

fixes.why: Second half of the same defect: the adverb list presents 是非 as fitting the までに + 〜ないと mould. This keeps the vocab item and its ref but states the environment 是非 actually takes, so the learner does not produce 是非…ないと. Tag multiset unchanged.

fixes.current: fica na forma de dicionário (afirmativa ou negativa), nunca na forma -ます.

Text-node-internal edit, no new tags, points the learner at the example already below.

fixes.why: Same false blanket rule repeated in a second learner-facing field, plus the same 'forma de dicionário' mislabel of the plain negative 落ちない. Keeps the exercise's own answer key intact and now agrees with the body.
